messages:
sam: quick ask from product: can the route card show a single 'net token delta' that folds in cache hits, prefetch amortization, and infra share? they want an easy number for billing conversations.
yara: doable, but we need to be explicit about semantics. There are three pieces: 1) direct token cost, 2) cache_credit (savings from KV/prefix hits), 3) allocated_prefetch_infra (cost of prefetch compute/storage spread across consumers). net_delta = direct_cost - cache_credit + allocated_infra.
mike: allocation options: a) consumer-weighted (tokens used), b) trigger-owner (only the trigger gets credit), c) proportional by route-traffic share, d) manual mapping for enterprise. Recommend (a) as default; (b) is easy but misleading.
yara: sampling caveat: invocation payloads are sampled at ~3%, while prefetch events are high-fidelity. if we join sampled invocations to full prefetch table we need sample_weight and unbiased estimators. analytics should carry sample_rate and use weighted_sum.
elllen: UI/UX: show net number prominently, with a small caret to expand breakdown. Add a confidence heat dot: green/yellow/red based on effective sample_count. Also allow toggling the allocation policy for investigation.
mike: analytics sketch (pseudo-sql):
WITH uses AS (
  SELECT prefetch_id, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(sample_weight) AS sw FROM invocation_samples WHERE ts >= :start GROUP BY prefetch_id, route
), totals AS (
  SELECT prefetch_id, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens FROM uses GROUP BY prefetch_id
), alloc AS (
  SELECT u.route, u.prefetch_id, COALESCE(u.tokens / NULLIF(t.total_tokens,0), 0) AS share, u.sw FROM uses u LEFT JOIN totals t USING(prefetch_id)
), allocated AS (
  SELECT route, SUM(share * p.estimated_cost * sw) / NULLIF(SUM(sw),1) AS allocated_prefetch_cost FROM alloc JOIN prefetch_events p USING(prefetch_id) GROUP BY route
)
SELECT route, SUM(direct_cost) - COALESCE(a.allocated_prefetch_cost, 0) + infra_share AS net_token_delta FROM route_costs LEFT JOIN allocated a USING(route) GROUP BY route;

yara: note the NULLIF guards divide-by-zero and we fallback to an epoch-amortized path when there are no sampled consumers for a prefetch_id. we'll mark those route-level rows with low confidence.
elllen: telemetry change requests: add optional fields to invocation telemetry: prefetch_id, observed_tokens, sample_weight. Also emit minute-level metric route.prefetch_utilization and route.sampled_consumer_count.
infra-bot: nightly-agg job completed (run=agg-174000) :white_check_mark:
sam: rollout plan: 1) emit proto fields behind flag, 2) run nightly prototype aggregator for 14 days and surface apportioned vs trigger-only diffs for top 250 routes, 3) UI dev-mode toggle and confidence indicators, 4) default to consumer-weighted if median diff < 12%, else default to conservative trigger-owner and escalate to product.
mike: stats note: compute approximate normal CI from weighted sums for all routes; run bootstrap for top-k routes only to keep cost down. show 95% CI in UI.
yara: alerting: add alert when route.prefetch_utilization drops >40% in 15m or when net_token_delta increases >30% week-over-week. tag eng-sre for thresholds.
elllen: I'll mock the expanded breakdown card: fields = raw_token_cost, cache_credit, allocated_prefetch_cost, infra_share, net_token_delta, CI, sample_count. will post PNG.
sam: engineering owners: mike (analytics proto + aggregator), yara (sampling math + fallback), ellen (frontend mock + tooltip copy). I'll coordinate experiment and sync in next eng-platform meeting. :rocket:
